summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## ARCA-61 — Plan (no code changed)  ### What I checked first Before proposing a fix, I read the actual chain end-to-end (read-only): `WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `server.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`.  **Finding, and it matters for how we proceed:** the chain looks correctly wired, not obviously broken. - Client never touches localStorage for watchlist data (only theme uses localStorage) and never renders `WatchlistPage` unless `useAuth()` has a real signed-in user. - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on
